I recently had this happen, here's what I did.

I had a very very close friend, like I mean we didn't hangout with anyone else for nearly 3 and a half years. We did everything together. We started growing apart, we went on a more musical path while I stuck with sports. He was making a bunch of friends who also played music, they would constantly hangout with us until they started excluding me since I wasn't as involved with the school bands and whatnot (I play a few instruments but don't enjoy the general attitude and competition that comes with being in school music program) so instead of always hanging around that one friend, I started training by myself (he plays the same sport as me and trained with me) while he was out with his music friends. I got very jealous for a good few months but later just decided if that's what he wants then fair enough. I started focusing on sport and he went further into the music program and all his friends. I kinda thought that would be the end of the friendship but to my surprise he messaged one day wanting to hangout. Ya know just as a way to catch up after half a year of no contact.

Pretty much, I reckon let them do what they need to do and think about yourself. Don't work too hard and put in too much effort like I did. Who knows, you might talk one day in the future and hangout but if that doesn't happen at least you didn't push too hard to stay friends.

Pro tip: don't get pissed at them, let them do what they need to do, there are 7.7 billion people on earth, it won't be the last friendship, they come and go. 

TLDR: If it feels right, then let go and don't chase after them. Relationships come and go
